meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, Mark all mandatory: the vendor accepts one of the two clauses
warnings: moved open_create to the front — the steps before it had no create screen to act on
moved open_create to the front — the steps before it had no create screen to act on

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Keep the eRFX event on an Auction stage.
Apply an auction template before adding line items.
Add the product the vendor will quote.

args.goal: On the buyer's Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the Auction create screen.

steps.note: Configure the two clauses and the stage-wide mandatory setting, which has no more specific catalog step.
Complete the auction pricing sheet for the line item.
Invite one QA test vendor to the event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's auction bid sheet as the vendor.
Confirm the first mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Confirm the second mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to quote 100 after accepting only one clause; the vendor submission must be blocked because the other mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
